10.2.12 CanTTController
[ECUC_Can_00001] Definition of EcucParamConfContainerDef CanTTController
⌈
Container Name
CanTTController
Parent Container
CanController
Description
CanTTController is specified in the SWS TTCAN and contains the configuration
parameters of the TTCAN controller(s) (which are needed in addition to the
configuration parameters of the CAN controller(s)).
This container is only included and valid if TTCAN is supported by the controller,
enabled (see CanSupportTTCANRef, ECUC_Can_00430), and used.
